Security policy

Source: SECURITY.md

reprokit runs locally in your R session. It handles no credentials, makes no network connections and sends no data anywhere.

If you find a problem that you think should not be discussed in public (for example, output that would reveal more about participants than the disclosure check says), report it privately through GitHub: on the repository page, open the Security tab and choose Report a vulnerability (https://github.com/dm-k1/reprokit/security/advisories/new). Please do not open a public issue for it.

Only the latest version on the main branch is supported. Ordinary bugs go to the issue tracker.
